details.description: Code Llama - Instruct 70B is Meta's instruction-tuned version of the 70B Code Llama base model, fine-tuned to follow natural-language coding instructions for code-assistant and chat-style use. Meta released it January 29, 2024 alongside the 70B base and Python checkpoints, and its Hugging Face model card notes it uses a different Source/Destination, <step>-token chat prompt format than the smaller Code Llama - Instruct sizes.
advantages: Scores 67.8% pass@1 on HumanEval, the highest score of any Code Llama size or variant reported in Meta's own paper (Code Llama paper, Table 2).
Scores 62.2% pass@1 on MBPP (Code Llama paper, Table 2).
disadvantages: Does not support the extended up-to-100,000-token inference context available for other Code Llama sizes, per its Hugging Face model card.
Unlike the 7B and 13B Code Llama sizes, the 34B and 70B models were not trained with fill-in-the-middle (infilling) capability (Meta Code Llama blog).
use_cases: Following natural-language instructions to write, explain, or review code

sources.title: Code Llama: A state-of-the-art large language model for coding
Code Llama: Open Foundation Models for Code

notes: Catalog's max_input/max_output_tokens of 4096 matches both Fireworks' listed ~4.09k-token serving context and the Hugging Face card's statement that, unlike the 70B base model, this Instruct variant does not support the extended 100K-token inference context.
